fusions.name: Raid the Comb
fusions.desc: Sends the swarm into the first enemy it meets for 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Hive
fusions.desc: Shakes a swarm loose in a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm in Tow
fusions.desc: Turns the swarm chasing you onto your enemies for 12 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second. Each kill restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Busy Fingers
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you restore 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
